cohort: 908 postpartum women were recruited from postnatal clinics and neonatal units in two rural districts of KwaZulu-Natal, South Africa.
finding: Women in rural South African health facilities experience disrespect, lack of trust, and limited involvement in care decisions, indicating a need for interventions addressing organisational cultures.
mod_finding: The mean Person-centred Maternity Care (PCMC) score was significantly higher for women who had caesarean deliveries compared with vaginal births.
